title: Rejected prompt-delivery receipts keep the full queued entry, attachments included, in the persisted session row with no expiry
outcome: Rejected prompt-delivery receipts keep the full queued entry, attachments included, in the persisted session row with no expiry
acceptance: A rejected receipt's retained QueuedPromptRecord (PromptDelivery.entry, src/prompt_delivery.rs) is bounded or expired, for example cleared on the oldest settled rejected receipts or replaced by a content reference, so attachments are not stored twice indefinitely; the retention rule is documented next to the receipt cap.
A test shows the retained entries stay within the documented bound across many rejected receipts.
